Zhang Daqian's splashed-ink brushstrokes outline the contours, while Fu Baoshi's freehand brushwork handles the flowing robes. The texture is rendered through ink wash, with a black, white, and gray tone. Only the cinnabar-red tassel of the sword, black jade, mutton-fat jade hairpin, and light blue sword tassel serve as fixed accent colors. 

The male lead wears a dark black robe with hidden patterns (the cuffs are embroidered with silver bamboo leaf patterns, exuding a strong sense of drape), a gold hair crown (with black jade inlaid on the side of the crown), a 1cm small vertical scar on the left forehead, narrow and long phoenix eyes (with the outer corners upturned and jet-black pupils), a high straight nose, thin lips, and a sharp jawline. He holds a black sandalwood scabbard in his right hand (adorned with a cinnabar-red tassel and cloud patterns on the hilt guard) and black cloth boots.

The female lead is dressed in a plain white sheer gauze long skirt (the hem is embroidered with light blue bamboo patterns, with an inner moon-white undergarment, giving a translucent feel). Her black hair is half-up, with a mutton-fat jade hairpin in her hair and strands of hair hanging down her shoulders. She has willow-leaf eyebrows (with the outer ends slightly raised), a small delicate nose, and cherry lips (in a light pink shade). She holds a pair of swords (with slender blades, black jade inlaid on the hilt guards, and light blue tassels) and wears moon-white cloth boots.

The two stand in a confrontational stance with the tips of their swords touching. Their robes flutter slightly, accompanied by ink wash effects. Bamboo leaves are flying, clouds and mist are swirling, and mountain rocks are faintly visible, creating a highly dramatic scene. 1-2s：
镜头缓慢推进至男女主角面部特写，男子眼神凌厉带笑，女子眸光沉静如水，嘴角极细微弧度暗藏锋芒。镜头轻微晃动感模拟呼吸起伏，强化心理张力。

2-3s：

最终固定远景扫过整座宗门废墟般的建筑轮廓，烟消云散之际唯见一轮孤月悬垂天际映照大地，众人皆伫足屏息，仿佛时间在此刻被按下了暂停键——留下无限遐想空间。
